decisions.topic: Medkit treatment choices and exclusion of Light-Wound healing
decisions.proposed_question: What are the two alternative treatments offered by a Medkit, can it directly heal an undressed Serious Wound or heal Light Wounds, and what are its Action-card cost and disposal after use?
decisions.proposed_expected_answer: Pay 1 Action card and choose either Dress 1 Serious Wound OR Heal 1 Dressed Serious Wound. It does not directly heal an undressed Serious Wound and offers no Light-Wound healing option. It is One Use Only, so discard the Medkit after use. Dressing retains the Serious Wound count; healing the dressed Wound discards its card.

raw_source_references.location: Actions from Item cards: readable Medkit illustration, cost1 / One Use Only / Dress1 Serious OR Heal1 Dressed Serious
Medikit illustration: Pansez 1 blessure grave OU Soignez 1 blessure grave pansée; compatible supplement only

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: Can Medkit and Bandages be used on other Characters?
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Only asks whether Medkit/Bandages may target others. Its yes key supplies no treatment options; cannot repair the key to silently enlarge this narrow request.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: What are the three mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatments; does dressing remove the Wound or merely its effect, and do identical Serious Wound effects stack?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Dress all Serious OR heal one dressed Serious OR heal all Light. Dress flips/ignores effect but retains Serious count; identical Serious effects do not stack.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Emergency Room menu is Dress ALL Serious OR Heal1 dressed OR Heal ALL Light. Applying that whole menu to Medkit would wrongly allow Light healing or dressing all; the Medkit-specific subset is never asked.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: Outside Combat, what can a single use of Bandages do to Wounds, and what two alternatives does Clothes offer? Can Bandages heal an undressed Serious Wound directly? Give each Item's Action-card cost and whether its alternatives can be combined in one use.
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Bandages costs 1 Action card and either dresses 1 Serious Wound OR heals all Light Wounds. It does not directly heal/discard an undressed Serious Wound. Clothes costs 1 Action card and either discards a Slime marker OR dresses 1 Serious Wound. Choose one effect per Item use; both are Out of Combat Only and One Use Only, so discard the used Item.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Explicitly asks Bandages and Clothes. Neither includes healing a dressed Serious Wound. These Item menus do not state the Medkit menu.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: At three Serious Wounds, does dressing one prevent death from a Light Wound? What happens at a third Light Wound otherwise, what does Heal remove, and where do a dead Characters Corpse and Heavy Objects go?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: No: dressed still counts; any further Wound kills at three Serious. Third Light clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. Heal removes specified Light Wound or discards dressed Serious card. Place Corpse and drop Heavy Objects in death Room.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Defines dressing/healing and thresholds; does not specify which treatment the Medkit allows.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: You perform the Action printed on a One Use Only Item. Besides paying its Action-card cost and showing it, what happens to the Item card after use?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Discard the Item card to the appropriate Item discard pile after using it. This is in addition to discarding the Action cards needed to pay its Action cost.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks generic one-use disposal. Cost/disposal are context here, not the claimed novelty.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: What defines being in Combat, how do In Combat Only and Out of Combat Only restrictions work, and may an unmarked Action or Item be used in either situation? Do Eggs cause Combat?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Sharing Room with Intruder defines Combat, not Eggs. In Combat Only requires it, Out of Combat Only requires none. Unmarked card/Item actions can be used in either subject to requirements; Basic Actions in Combat are limited to Shoot, Melee and Basic Movement as Escape. No Room Actions or Quest activation in Combat.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Only combat-state/icon legality, no Medkit menu; proposal does not rely on obscured combat icon.

decisions.not_cosmetic: The decisive fact is a different legal Item treatment menu: Medkit can heal a dressed Serious Wound but cannot heal Light Wounds. This is not a renamed Bandages target or additional quantity under a requested Medkit procedure. Compared with Q36, both the light-healing omission and the inability to dress all Serious Wounds materially change the legal output of one use; generic operation definitions alone cannot choose this menu. Printed cost/name/disposal alone are not novelty.
decisions.legibility: English treatment lines and cost/one-use label readable; do not infer its obscured upper-right combat icon.
decisions.author_reason: The raw Medkit supplies Dress1 Serious OR Heal1 Dressed Serious. Q16 asks the definitions; Q36 already asks Dress/Heal-dressed branches, Q112 asks Dress1 and excludes direct undressed Serious healing, Q99 asks others-targeting, Q55 icon legality, Q61 disposal and Q03 OR/payment. There is no printed undressed-healing exception or new healing operation. Its subset of existing treatments, changed carrier, dose and cost do not meet the coordinator novelty criterion. Do not transfer Emergency Room options to the Item: generic card-text controls remain applicable. Preserve independent proposal and disagreement; keep complete menu in the summary, without a redundant quiz request.

decisions.topic: Complete Player Phase round scheduling and transition gate
decisions.proposed_question: After every player has had one round of two Actions, does the Event Phase begin automatically? Describe who takes the next round, the order and size of rounds while players remain active, what happens when a player takes only one Action or none, and exactly when the Player Phase ends.
decisions.proposed_expected_answer: Starting with the First Player, proceed clockwise, each active player taking a round of 2 Actions. After everyone has had a round, repeat rounds in that order while at least one player has not passed. Taking only 1 Action requires passing; taking none or being unable to act requires passing. Players who have passed are skipped for ordinary later Actions in this Player Phase; the FAQ permits Interruption after passing. Begin the Event Phase only after all players have passed.

raw_source_references.location: Player Phase step3 Player Rounds; repeated two-Action rounds clockwise until all pass

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks card refill, token passing, deck exhaustion and discard destinations. Neither request nor key supplies repeated clockwise rounds or the all-passed gate.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: A Character in a burning Room takes one Action then passes. When do they take Fire damage, can they act again this Player Phase, can they discard cards, and do later players rounds burn them again?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: At end of own round take 1 Light Wound. Passing bars normal Actions this Player Phase, but official FAQ permits Interruption after passing. May discard any number of hand cards on passing. No further Fire wounds from later players rounds this turn.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks one Character taking an Action then passing, Fire damage, further Actions and discards. Explains individual pass consequences but not how all players rounds repeat or terminate the phase.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: After two Actions your hand is empty. Do you automatically pass then, and what timing consequence can Fire or Bleeding have?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: No automatic pass. Wait for next round to pass; can suffer Fire/Bleeding again because passing ends another round.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Assumes a two-Action round and asks when an empty-hand player passes. Its next-round timing does not ask who next acts or what collective condition starts Event Phase.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: Give the Event Phase order, which Intruders move on an Event card, what controls movement and when the event effect resolves; what happens when Event and Intruder Attack decks run out?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Time and active Self-Destruct advance, Intruders in Combat attack, Fire Damage, Event card movement then effect, bag development fully resolved before next turn. Move symbol-matching Intruders without Characters in Room via card-number Corridor; ducts remove miniature/return token. Discard Event unless instructed otherwise. Empty Event/Attack decks reshuffle their respective discard piles.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks Event Phase order, movement and deck exhaustion once that phase exists. It does not ask when Player Phase transitions into it.

decisions.not_cosmetic: The new requested procedure is phase control: repeat the cycle rather than one round per player, and gate Event Phase on all players passing. Individual pass, refill and Event-step rules do not themselves request this scheduling procedure.
decisions.author_reason: No existing actual stem asks the collective repeated clockwise two-Action scheduling loop or all-players-passed transition gate. Q04/Q91 cover individual passing consequences, Q23 draw/token/discards, Q24 Event steps. This adds actual phase control, not another pass example.

decisions.candidate_origin: Parent-provided lead from allowed original English p25 Canteen/Shower passages, independently assessed here.
decisions.topic: Canteen/Shower principal benefit plus optional additional scan, not OR
decisions.proposed_question: When you use Canteen or Shower, what non-scanning benefit does each Room give? Must you choose between that benefit and scanning Contamination, or can one Room Action give both? May you take the non-scanning benefit without choosing to scan?
decisions.proposed_expected_answer: Canteen heals 1 Light Wound. Shower discards your Slime marker if you have one. Each additionally permits you to choose to scan all Contamination cards in your hand and remove all non-Infected cards; that scan is optional and additional to the Room benefit, not an OR replacement. You may take the non-scanning benefit without scanning. If you do scan, resolve the infected/Larva consequences as normal. Pay the ordinary single Room Action cost, subject to common Room restrictions.

raw_source_references.location: Canteen and Shower Room: principal benefit followed by Additionally, you may choose to Scan all Contamination cards in your hand

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: Contrast Canteen/Shower scanning with Surgery: which cards are scanned and removed, how is a Larva handled, and what costs or turn consequences follow Surgery?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Canteen/Shower optionally scan hand Contamination, remove non-Infected; infected gives Larva and retains card, existing Larva means death/Creeper. Canteen heals 1 Light; Shower removes Slime. Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes infected and Larva, then 1 Light Wound, automatic pass, shuffle all cards including hand into deck; empty hand until next turn.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Stem is expressly a scanning-versus-Surgery comparison: scopes/removal, Larva and Surgery costs/turn consequences. Key volunteers Canteen healing and Shower Slime removal, but neither those benefits nor their optional additive relationship to scanning is actually requested.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: At three Serious Wounds, does dressing one prevent death from a Light Wound? What happens at a third Light Wound otherwise, what does Heal remove, and where do a dead Characters Corpse and Heavy Objects go?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: No: dressed still counts; any further Wound kills at three Serious. Third Light clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. Heal removes specified Light Wound or discards dressed Serious card. Place Corpse and drop Heavy Objects in death Room.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Defines Heal and injury/death thresholds; does not ask these Rooms effects or whether scanning replaces them.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: What are the three mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatments; does dressing remove the Wound or merely its effect, and do identical Serious Wound effects stack?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Dress all Serious OR heal one dressed Serious OR heal all Light. Dress flips/ignores effect but retains Serious count; identical Serious effects do not stack.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatment choices. Applying its OR structure to Canteen/Shower would give a wrong outcome; these Rooms provide their principal benefit AND an optional scan.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: Does entering Room Covered With Slime require an Action to acquire Slime, can it have an Item Counter or Malfunction, can Slime stack, and does showering extinguish Fire?
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Entry automatically gives Slime; no paid Action. No Item Counter, never Malfunction. Max one Slime, extra does nothing; Clothes/Shower remove. Shower does not remove Fire and Fire allowed there. On first entering the Room Covered With Slime, acquire Slime before resolving its Exploration token. Thus a Silence Exploration effect becomes Danger on that first entry, subject to the already-covered Careful Movement/Reconnaissance cancellation.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks Slime acquisition, counters/markers/stacking and whether Shower extinguishes Fire. Its key volunteers Shower removal, but stem does not request what Shower removes or whether scanning is additional.

closest_actual_requests.actual_request: Outside Combat, what can a single use of Bandages do to Wounds, and what two alternatives does Clothes offer? Can Bandages heal an undressed Serious Wound directly? Give each Item's Action-card cost and whether its alternatives can be combined in one use.
closest_actual_requests.actual_key: Bandages costs 1 Action card and either dresses 1 Serious Wound OR heals all Light Wounds. It does not directly heal/discard an undressed Serious Wound. Clothes costs 1 Action card and either discards a Slime marker OR dresses 1 Serious Wound. Choose one effect per Item use; both are Out of Combat Only and One Use Only, so discard the used Item.
closest_actual_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks Clothes/Bandages OR menus. Does not ask the additive optional scanning relationship in these Room Actions.

decisions.not_cosmetic: The decisive procedure is benefit plus optional scanning in one paid Room Action; unlike Emergency Room and Clothes/Bandages OR menus, selecting the scan does not forfeit the principal benefit. This is not merely changing a healing dose or moving an already-requested full Room procedure to a different carrier. Both paired Rooms are kept in one request.
decisions.author_reason: Accept only the new coupling/optionality request: one paid Room Action gives its principal benefit AND may additionally scan, and scan may be declined without forfeiting that benefit. Q17 asks scan/Surgery scopes, removal, Larva and Surgery consequences; its volunteered treatment context is not asked. Q45 asks entry/markers/stack/Fire; Q36/Q112 ask mutually exclusive OR treatments. This explicit additive-versus-replacement outcome is distinct from merely renaming a healing carrier or changing its dose. Pair both Rooms in one question.
